email.subject: Request for Price Reversion and Bulk Discounts
email.body:
Dear HARBOURLINE DRY GOODS PTE LTD,

I have noticed recent price increases for cooking oil and plain flour, which have significantly impacted our budget. Could we discuss reverting to the previous prices or offering bulk discounts? Your support would greatly help us manage our costs.

Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,
[Your name], [Your business]
